verdict.rationale: A state business-filing agency could plausibly offer a documented public API, so this axis applies. The evidence shows only web forms, paper or mail filing, and an online filing system; no documented API appears. Probes found no OpenAPI or Swagger spec at any candidate path and no llms.txt, and both the filing host and the Business Express portal reject automated agents. A searchable entity database is mentioned, but nothing documents programmatic access to it.
